members.statement: The cited explicit map has the form G(U)=U+H(U) over Q^24, with every nonzero component of H homogeneous cubic, determinant 1, 54 nonzero cubic monomials, and a displayed collision of two distinct rational points.
members.title: An explicit cubic-homogeneous counterexample in 24 variables

members.statement: Starting from the public 11D counterexample, rank-sensitive cubic suspension yields an explicit 19D cubic-homogeneous Keller counterexample with collision.

members.statement: Prove the extension statement E(N): no sl_r or sp_r prolongation extension of total dimension at most N satisfies the Engel, irreducibility, collision, and minimal-monolith conditions; E(16) gives a lower bound 17 and E(18) gives 19.
